text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... She settled into the midfield, but made her move a bit late. Still, that finishing burst is phenomenal.
That girl gets... an overall rating of A, I'd say.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Her cornering over there is exceptional.
She stays glued to the inner rail without losing speed.
Her core strength is phenomenal... SS rank it is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Unusually enough, an Umamusume was mingled among the trainers observing the course. If I recall, her name was Royce and Royce.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—That should do it for today.
Fufu, we gathered some useful data.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On another day—I spotted Royce and Royce at the gym once more. Today as well, she was intently observing the other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The reason the training menu differs from last week's……
Oh, she's switching to strengthening the triceps surae, I see.
I didn't think they were particularly weak, though.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I should adjust her ability matrix.
At this rate, her burst-related stats look likely to grow.
I'd like to check a mock race once, too.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Today's 'Most Popular Menu Items for Medium-Distance Umamusume'
are 1st, 2nd, 5th, 7th, 8th, 15th... and 18th and 22nd. What everyone's eating is—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I bumped into Royce and Royce as she suddenly spun around.
I managed to catch her smartphone just before it hit the ground.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... and thank you.
choice_data_list: You're always observing so intently, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah... So you noticed me.
Quite observant of you.
I'll make sure to reflect that in your matrix.
choice_data_list: You even made a matrix for me?
You even made a matrix for me?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You're a Trainer, so of course you are.
An Umamusume's abilities shift based on your guidance.
Your influence cannot be overlooked.
choice_data_list: Why analyze everything to such thorough detail?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
To determine the path I must walk――I wonder?
Hey, I want to be called "the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
In which category can one become the strongest?
Where do my own capabilities rank?
Without knowing that, the path to supreme strength will never open.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That is what all these matrices
and rankings are for.
choice_data_list: Is there a Wit matrix as well?
Is there a Wit matrix as well?
I'd like to check out the competitive eating rankings.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That is what all these matrices
and rankings are for.
choice_data_list: Is there a Wit matrix as well?
Is there a Wit matrix as well?
I'd like to check out the competitive eating rankings.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Which kind of "smarts" are you talking about?
Intuition, memory, standard academics...
Each one yields an entirely different result, you know.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
For instance, there's even an EQ ranking…… emotional intelligence quotient.
……Not that I'm going to tell you yours, though.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The competitive eating rankings... are still incomplete.
...There are too many people who are simply unmeasurable.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The food runs out before the top rankers can even get full! We can't measure their maximum capacity even once!
